artworks.title: Plate 61: Four Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays four snails, each with distinct features. The largest snail is positioned at the bottom center, with a light brown shell and a pale body. A medium-sized snail with a reddish-brown and cream spiral shell is located above it to the left. To the right, a slightly smaller snail with a dark shell and black body is shown. A small snail with a cream and brown shell is situated near the center left of the image. The background is a light off-white color, contrasting with the snails' earthy tones. The snails are arranged within an oval border on the page.

artworks.title: Plate 62: A Slug with Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows five distinct snails and a slug arranged within an oval boundary. The largest object is a brown, spiral-shelled snail in the top right corner. To its left is a yellow-shelled snail with a silky sheen, and below it, a smaller snail with a pink-tinted shell. In the top left corner, a dark slug with a speckled body is visible. The color palette includes earthy browns, yellows, and soft pinks against a pale background. The snails and slug are evenly spaced throughout the image, oriented inward, around the central smaller snail.

artworks.title: Plate 63: Seven Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting shows several snails. There are seven snails in total, some large and some small. Their bodies and shells are in shades of earthy tones such as brown, cream, and beige. The snails are arranged in a gold oval frame against the off-white background, with roman numerals on the right.

artworks.title: Plate 64: Leopard Slug, Ground Beetle Larva, a Rat-tailed Maggot, and Other Creatures
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several objects, including a long spotted slug at the bottom center. Other objects include a dark segmented insect on the mid-left and a brown shell-bearing snail on the upper right. The color palette includes pale beige, brown, black, and hints of pink. The spotted slug spans horizontally, with the insect above on the left and the snail above on the right. Other small specimens are spread out in the image.

artworks.title: Plate 60: Leafy Spurge Hawkmoth Caterpillar, Gray Dagger Caterpillar, and Pupae
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of caterpillars on a branch. The central branch displays various stages of caterpillar life. The main caterpillar has black, red, green, and cream tones, while smaller caterpillars with vibrant colors are on secondary branches. A brown chrysalis and a cocoon are also present. The background is cream-colored. This is in the style of Maria Sibylla Merian, known for detailed renderings of insects and plants.

artworks.title: Plate 66: Lackey Moth Caterpillar, Figure of Eight Caterpillar, Grey Dagger Caterpillar, and Other Caterpillars
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays various caterpillars of different sizes and colors, each illustrated within an oval border. The color palette consists of brown, black, tan, orange, green, blue, and yellow hues. Positioned around the oval are several caterpillars, including a fuzzy black and orange one at the top right, a blue and yellow-spotted one towards the lower left, a brown and black-striped one in the upper left corner, a small green one at the top center, a light grey one with black spots towards the bottom right, and other smaller caterpillars with various patterns and colors. The Roman numeral LXVI is located outside the right side of the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 67: Large White and Small White Butterfly Caterpillars, Hornworm Caterpillar, Broom Moth Caterpillar, and Others
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Several multicolored caterpillars are placed across branches in a frame. The color palette includes browns, greens, blues, reds, oranges, and yellows. The caterpillars show various shapes, sizes, and textures, some fuzzy, some spiky. Roman numerals "LXVII" are labeled on the right side.

artworks.title: Plate 68: Leafy Spurge Hawkmoth Caterpillar, Mullein Moth Caterpillar, and Other Caterpillars
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows six caterpillars of varying sizes and colors within an outlined oval shape on a neutral background. The largest caterpillar, located at the top, is predominantly green with lighter green stripes. The other caterpillars exhibit colors such as black, yellow, and brown, with patterns of spots or bands in white or orange. The caterpillars are evenly spaced within the oval, with one green caterpillar at the top, three centrally located, and two at the bottom, including a small curled brown one and a hairy orange and black one.

artworks.title: Plate 6: A Variety of Oxen with a Ram and a Water Buffalo(?) by a Plane Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pastoral scene with various animals. It depicts four different animals enclosed within a circular frame made by two trees. Each animal is numbered. On the left is a sheep with large, curled horns looking towards the interior space of the circle. In the center, there is a dark cow marked as number 2, standing next to a light-colored calf marked number 3. On the right is a goat with long, curved horns. The background consists of a grassy area and sparse foliage, including a tree with broad leaves. The top and bottom of the image contain Latin text. The phrase at the top reads "Equus in quadrigis, in aratro bos," and the bottom phrase reads "Non nostrum onus, bos clitellas."

artworks.title: Plate 69: Emperor Moth Caterpillar with a Second Caterpillar on a Branch
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two large caterpillars on different branches. One caterpillar is yellowish-brown with blue and black accents, while the other is green with orange spots. The color palette is earthy with green, yellow, and brown tones. The caterpillars are positioned on the branches in the image labeled "LXIX" on the right side.

artworks.title: Plate 70: Worm, Centipede, Millipede, and Other Long Creatures
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 71: Empty Oval
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows an elongated, closed curve resembling an oval or an egg shape drawn in a single continuous line. This abstract shape is placed on a plain background with minimal features. To the right of the shape, there is a small marking or text "LXXI."

artworks.title: Plate 7: A Bull and a Horned Animal
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two bovine animals depicted with detailed anatomical features and an ornate branch with fruit above them. The painting shows a large gray bovine in the foreground while a smaller, reddish-brown one grazes behind it. Above the animals, a branch with two pomegranates hangs, intertwined with a scroll containing text. The composition is set within an oval, framed by Latin inscriptions both above and below the creatures. The artwork is marked with Roman numeral VII on the right.

artworks.title: Plate 8: A Cow
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: A cow is the central and largest object in a grassy field with distant trees and a wooden fence in the background. The color palette consists of earthy browns, soft greens, and touches of blue, with the cow appearing in shades of brown against the greenery of the field. The cow is positioned centrally, facing slightly to the left, while the trees create a backdrop, and the fencing appears near the horizon line. A small pond is visible towards the bottom left.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated title page featuring the title "ANIMALIA AQVATILIA ET CÖCHILIATA" in the center. The border surrounding the text includes pastel-colored decorative elements such as ribbons, tassels, floral motifs, and beads. At the top, there is an aquatic-themed decoration with a vessel labeled "AQVA" releasing stylized water arcs. The drawing is framed with delicate scrollwork.

artworks.title: Plate 9: A Great White(?) Shark, Two Seals, and Two Fish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various marine creatures. The image features multiple animals, including a seal or similar marine mammal biting into a fish with visible blood, a larger fish or cetacean with an open mouth, a smaller fish below, and a creature immersed almost entirely, showing only its head above the water. The scene is set within an oval frame. The artistic style is precise, emphasizing detailed forms and textures.

artworks.title: Plate 10: Nine Sharks
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various sea creatures. The drawing shows an assortment of fish in different shapes and colors, arranged within an oval frame set against a blue background representing water. The fish have detailed features with various patterns like spots and stripes, depicted in different orientations to show side and top views. The scene conveys a sense of scientific curiosity and documentation, with each creature meticulously illustrated. The sandy bottom under some fish hints at a seabed environment.

artworks.title: Plate 11: Four Fish and Shells
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image consists of four fish and seashells in an oval frame. The fish are swimming to the right, transitioning into sandy ground where the seashells are located. The fish vary in color, with the largest one in blue with red fins, and the smaller fish in shades of brown and gold. The seashells are in earthy tones of beige, brown, and pink.

artworks.title: Plate 12: A Swordfish and Three Other Fish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Four fish in various colors are depicted in the image. The largest fish is towards the bottom right, with the smallest near the center-right. The swordfish-like fish is positioned in the upper half towards the left, while the other three fish are swimming horizontally beneath it, filling the lower half. The circular vignette is outlined with a thin orange line, and the number "XII" appears to the right.

artworks.title: Plate 13: Two Stingrays, an Anglerfish, a Monkfish(?) and an  Angel Shark
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sea creatures against a blue background. The creatures are depicted in a detailed artistic style, each unique in appearance. The left side shows a skate or ray, followed by a fish with long appendages and a large mouth. To the right is a creature resembling a butterfly ray, and below it, a fish with a fan-like structure on its back. A shark-like fish is at the lower right. The creatures are drawn with emphasis on their forms and textures, with shading and color variations for depth. The image is enclosed within a circle.

artworks.title: Plate 14: A "Sea Ape," Two Scorpion Fish, and Two Other Fish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image contains five fish-like creatures within an oval frame. The first creature resembles a seal or mermaid, the second is a long, slender green fish, the third is a spiky, bulbous-headed pink fish, the fourth is a wide-bodied blue fish with a long tail, and the fifth is a flat, brown, worm-like creature on the seabed. The background shows a light blue water surface and a light brown seabed. The creatures are arranged diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, with the seabed in the foreground. A gold oval border surrounds the scene, with text above and below.

artworks.title: Plate 15: Six "Asellorum" Fish (Cod?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows six fish of varying sizes, shapes, and textures within an elliptical frame. The colors predominantly include shades of blue, gray, brown, and beige against a pale blue background. A thin yellow border surrounds the elliptical frame.

artworks.title: Plate 16: Eels, Pipefish, and Needlefish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows various types of eels and elongated fish species within a circular frame. There is a coiled eel at the bottom left, with other fish and eels distributed throughout the image. The color palette includes soft blues, earthy browns, pink, and muted greens. Latin inscriptions are present above and below the circle.

artworks.title: Plate 17: A Cod, Weever Fish, Eels, and Other Fish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The illustration depicts various species of fish as the largest objects, each labeled with numbers. The color palette includes muted browns, blues, grays, and hints of pink, against a light background and a sea with blue and sandy tones. The fish are arranged in a semi-circular pattern within a border, with the largest fish at the top center and smaller fish descending towards the bottom. The fish are horizontally oriented, with a shoreline on the left side and smaller elements like shells at the bottom.
